# Choreo Planer

> Choreo Planer is a free online tool for planning cheerleading and dance
> choreography. It builds countsheets, manages teams, seasons, members and
> positions, and exports to PDF or video.

Choreo Planer is a single-page web application at https://www.choreo-planer.de.
A public REST API is documented at https://api.choreo-planer.de/openapi.json,
and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is available at
https://api.choreo-planer.de/mcp. Every feature is available at no cost.

## Start here

- [Help and FAQ](https://www.choreo-planer.de/hilfe): How to create an account, build a countsheet, assign positions, and export.
- [Pricing](https://www.choreo-planer.de/pricing.md): The full pricing statement. The tool is free.
- [Contact](https://www.choreo-planer.de/contact): Reach the maintainers at info@choreo-planer.de.

## Scoped indexes

- [Full guide (llms-full.txt)](https://www.choreo-planer.de/llms-full.txt): The complete long-form agent guide in one file.
- [Documentation index](https://www.choreo-planer.de/docs/llms.txt): Scoped context for user help and reference docs.
- [API index](https://www.choreo-planer.de/api/llms.txt): Scoped context for the REST API and MCP server.
- [Developer index](https://www.choreo-planer.de/developers/llms.txt): Scoped context for developers and agents.

## API

- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://api.choreo-planer.de/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of every REST endpoint.
- [Interactive API documentation](https://api.choreo-planer.de/api-docs): Swagger UI for browsing and testing endpoints.
- [Generated API reference](https://www.choreo-planer.de/docs/): Per-module reference documentation.
- [Service health](https://api.choreo-planer.de/health): Current status of all backing services.
- [API catalog](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 catalog of the published APIs.

## Agent access

- [Agent guide](https://www.choreo-planer.de/agents.md): When to use Choreo Planer and how to call it.
- [MCP server](https://api.choreo-planer.de/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint for agent access. Requires a JWT bearer token.
- [Authentication guide](https://api.choreo-planer.de/auth.md): How to obtain an MCP access token and send it as a bearer token.
- [MCP server card](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Identity, transport, supported protocol versions and tool previews for the MCP server.
- [Agent card (A2A)](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent-to-agent card describing capabilities and skills.
- [Agent skills index](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Catalog of agent skills backed by the REST API and MCP server.
- [MCP catalog](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Discovery document advertising the MCP server card.
- [ChatGPT / plugin manifest](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Plugin manifest pointing to the OpenAPI spec.
- [Protected resource metadata](https://api.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 metadata for the MCP endpoint.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery manifest](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ard.json): Describes the REST API and the MCP server as agentic resources.
- [skills.sh](https://www.choreo-planer.de/skills.sh): One-line bootstrap printing the connection details.
- [Crawler policy](https://www.choreo-planer.de/robots.txt): robots.txt, including explicit rules for AI crawlers.

## Legal

- [Imprint](https://www.choreo-planer.de/impressum): Legal notice and operator details.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.choreo-planer.de/datenschutz): How personal data is processed.
